scope.selection: 429 unique unordered star triples represented within the 500 most precise retained chain records

methodology.deduplication: Records sharing unorderedGroupKey are merged into one star triple; alternate ordered chains remain in orderedVariants.
methodology.evaluation: Each unique triple is evaluated against a reusable biblical-motif ontology derived from the three existing Heavens Remember semantic meanings. Specific three-way motifs take precedence over broad thematic matches.
methodology.starNames: Star-name etymologies are deliberately excluded from semantic scoring until source-verified.

statusMeaning.strong: A specific passage or tight passage cluster naturally binds all three semantic elements.
statusMeaning.plausible: A coherent biblical motif binds the triple, but requires synthesis or a broader passage cluster.
statusMeaning.weak: Only two elements form a clear biblical relation; the third remains loose.
statusMeaning.no_match: No sufficiently specific three-way biblical relation was identified.
